scripts.build: npm run build:java && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:java: npm run install:rbed && mvn -q -f scenarios/pom.xml package -DskipTests -Drbed.version=$(npm run -s rbed:version)
scripts.test: npm run install:rbed && mvn -q -f scenarios/pom.xml verify -Drbed.version=$(npm run -s rbed:version) && node --test test/*.test.mjs
